title: Critique: quantum indeterminacy cancels out before it reaches behavior

statements.text: Some argue that quantum indeterminacy shows itself only at the subatomic level and cancels out by the scale of even very small macroscopic objects, while behavior is macroscopic, so it leaves no room for a mind to steer the brain.

sources.quote: Some argue that indeterminacy manifests itself only on the subatomic level, being cancelled out by the time one reaches even very tiny macroscopic objects
